name: BaqFlo SlideGallery
author: baqflo

sections.description:
Build Beautiful Image Galleries Your Visitors Will Love

Create responsive image galleries, touch-friendly image carousels and elegant fullscreen image popups without the complexity of traditional gallery plugins.

Whether you’re showcasing photography, promoting products, documenting projects or creating a business website, BaqFlo SlideGallery makes building professional galleries quick, intuitive and enjoyable.

Designed to be lightweight, responsive and easy to use, SlideGallery helps your images look their best on every device.

Why Choose SlideGallery?

Lightweight by Design

SlideGallery only loads its frontend assets on pages where a gallery is actually displayed, helping keep your website fast and efficient.

Responsive Everywhere

Every gallery automatically adapts to desktop, tablet and mobile devices, ensuring your images always look their best.

Beautiful Fullscreen Image Popups

Give visitors an immersive viewing experience with elegant fullscreen image popups built directly into the plugin.

Simple Gallery Builder

Create attractive galleries in minutes using an intuitive drag-and-drop interface.

Works With Your Theme

Designed to blend naturally into virtually any modern WordPress theme without requiring complicated setup.

Core Features

  • Responsive image galleries
  • Responsive image carousels
  • Fullscreen image popups
  • Drag-and-drop gallery builder
  • Image captions
  • Optional image links
  • Flexible gallery display settings
  • Mobile-friendly touch navigation
  • Lightweight frontend loading
  • Shortcode support for easy placement

Perfect For

SlideGallery is ideal for creating:

  • Photography portfolios
  • Product showcases
  • Restaurant and café websites
  • Artist and designer portfolios
  • Travel blogs
  • Business websites
  • Documentation galleries
  • Marketing pages
  • Event galleries
  • Customer showcases

Built for Speed

Fast websites create better visitor experiences.

SlideGallery has been designed to stay lightweight by loading frontend assets only when a gallery is present on the page. Combined with responsive rendering and efficient code, this helps your galleries look fantastic without unnecessarily slowing down your website.

Ready for More? Upgrade to SlideGallery Pro

SlideGallery Pro expands the same simple workflow with powerful presentation features for creators, businesses and professionals.

Unlock Pro features including:

  • Video galleries
  • PDF popups
  • Website and iframe popups
  • Mixed media galleries
  • Linked popup galleries
  • Advanced popup controls
  • Additional gallery layouts
  • Future premium enhancements

Whether you’re presenting products, tutorials, documentation or interactive content, SlideGallery Pro helps you create richer media experiences while keeping the familiar workflow you already know.

Learn more about SlideGallery Pro:

https://baqflo.com/slidegallery/

Built by BaqFlo

SlideGallery is part of the growing BaqFlo family of WordPress plugins.

Our goal is simple: build professional WordPress plugins that are fast, thoughtfully designed and genuinely enjoyable to use.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate BaqFlo SlideGallery.
  2. Create a new gallery from the SlideGallery menu.
  3. Select images from your Media Library.
  4. Configure your gallery settings.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode into any page, post or widget.
sections.faq:
Will my galleries work on phones and tablets?

Yes. Every gallery automatically adapts to desktop, tablet and mobile devices.

Can I create image carousels?

Absolutely. Any gallery can be displayed as a responsive image carousel.

Can visitors open images in fullscreen?

Yes. The free version includes elegant fullscreen image popups.

Can I display multiple galleries on one page?

Yes. Each gallery has its own shortcode, allowing you to display as many galleries as you like.

Can I edit a gallery after publishing it?

Yes. Simply update the gallery and your changes appear everywhere the shortcode is used.

Does SlideGallery slow down my website?

No. Frontend assets are only loaded on pages where a gallery is displayed.

What extra features are included in SlideGallery Pro?

SlideGallery Pro adds support for videos, PDFs, webpages, mixed media galleries, linked popup galleries and additional presentation features.

Can I upgrade later without rebuilding my galleries?

Yes. Existing galleries continue working exactly as before. Upgrading simply unlocks additional Pro features.

Where can I learn more about SlideGallery Pro?

https://baqflo.com/slidegallery/
sections.changelog:
1.01

  • Added automatic migration to the new BaqFlo plugin-specific data format while preserving existing galleries and settings.
  • Improved compatibility between the Lite and Pro editions, allowing seamless upgrades and downgrades without losing gallery data.
  • Improved licence and update handling for existing Pro installations.
  • Updated internal architecture for future compatibility across the BaqFlo plugin framework.
  • Various compatibility, stability and maintenance improvements.

1.00

  • Initial WordPress.org release.
